Screen built at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- **Profile details**: editable name/email/phone fields (mock data pre-filled), Save button enabled only on change, with a transient "Saved" confirmation.
- **Notification preferences**: four accessible on/off switches (role="switch") with labels and descriptions, mock defaults.
- **Close account**: danger-zone button opens an `alertdialog` confirmation listing exactly what will be lost, requires checking "I understand this action is permanent" before the final destructive button is enabled; Escape/overlay click/Cancel dismiss it; confirming shows a closed-account state.

Since `node_modules` isn't installed and the `@strata/*` packages live outside this folder (so I couldn't inspect their API without reading outside the working directory), I used plain semantic HTML/React state instead of guessing at `@strata/react` component props, and styled everything with Strata's CSS custom properties (with sensible fallbacks) plus logical properties so it should adapt correctly across brands, light/dark, density, and RTL locales.
